verification.notes: Hull's hearing testimony confirms that Farnsworth originally provided a flash drive and later downloadable electronic versions. The testimony excerpt does not affirmatively say that an original SD card was never provided to any investigator. Treating the testimony's silence as proof of non-delivery would be an absence inference, so the flash-drive portion is confirmed but the categorical original-SD-card conclusion is not.

records.text: Owens says Hull’s narration of the prosecution footage seemed remarkably rehearsed and accuses the presentation of intentionally confusing viewers and leading them to believe Maroon Boy immediately parked and walked to a TPUSA representative; she allows that this may be true but says it is not the whole truth.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: His testimony that he gave over the footage registered to me as remarkably rehearsed. Like they put that sizzle reel together, they got him in there and they were like, okay, pick up the pace, keep talking over it. Just keep, okay, we're going to do it again. ... That was meant to confuse people. Your brain was trying to make sense of what he was saying versus what your eyes were observing, what you were hearing versus what you were seeing. And at times we went back and realized those two things were in conflict with one another. ... The end result is that we were intentionally led to believe. That maroon boy arrived onto campus, pulled into the parking structure, parked, exited his vehicle, and then walked down near the amphitheater to find a TPUSA rep. ... And maybe that's the truth, but I can tell you today that it's certainly not the whole truth because the whole truth.
